title: Streamlined series summary flows and priority rendering
creator: Ava Kim
description:
Problem statement:
Teams building dashboards are seeing long paint times and janky interactions when a view contains >40 small timeseries lines + legend. The Console needs a compact summary mode (for list / overview screens) that retains meaningful signal while drastically reducing DOM nodes and GPU work, and also meets WCAG keyboard/voiceover requirements.

Goals:
- Introduce a "summary" rendering mode for small, high-cardinality timeseries that uses precomputed micro-aggregates and simplified SVG/canvas mixes to cut render cost by ~4x on typical pages.
- Provide a legend/tooltip behaviour that is accessible (keyboard focus, aria-live summary, reduced DOM for screenreaders) while still allowing detailed drill-in on hover/click.
- Implement a priority-driven render pipeline that renders visible + high-priority series immediately and defers low-priority series via progressive hydration.
- Ensure API surface (tokens, props) allows product teams to opt into modes per-route (overview vs. detail) and ties to runtime rollout flags.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not change the query/ingestion layer or server cache logic. We are focusing on client render heuristics and design components.

Design constraints and considerations:
- Maintain visual parity for signal (peak, trend, recent delta) even when decimating points. Use an adaptive sampling heuristic that preserves peaks and inflection points.
- When in compact mode, shift tooltip behaviour to an "announce-only" aria summary on hover/focus, with an explicit "open details" affordance to show full interactive tooltip.
- Use CSS tokens for condensed spacing, stroke thickness, and color mapping so product teams can align theme variants.
- Provide fallback to simplified DOM tree for assistive tech to avoid hundreds of nodes being read out.
- Ensure compatibility with existing Canvas fallback and WebGL experiments in runtime-1.20.

Deliverables:
- Figma comps for Summary mode (list and card sizes) + interaction specs for keyboard navigation and tooltip affordance.
- Component API spec (props, events, tokens) for SummaryChart, SummaryLegend, and SummaryTooltip.
- Implementation notes and recommended batching heuristics for frontend engineers (including pseudocode for priority pipeline).
- Accessibility test checklist and small automated Axe/VoiceOver script examples.

Risks / Trade-offs:
- Decimation may hide short anomalous spikes; expose an opt-out flag for safety-critical dashboards.
- Progressive hydration increases perceived latency for low-priority series but reduces main-thread contention. Need to tune thresholds with telemetry.
- Screen reader simplified DOM might make precise series counts harder to announce; include an aria summary that mentions counts and top-3 signals instead.
acceptance_criteria: Design comps delivered in Figma including small/medium/large card variations and legend collapsed state
Component API doc reviewed and approved by frontend and platform teams
Prototype implemented in frontend playground that reduces first-paint JS main-thread by >=40% on a synthetic 60-series view
Keyboard-only navigation covers legend focus, series toggle, and an explicit 'open details' action with aria announcements
Perf dashboard (Grafana panel) added to show render latency by series count and prioritized/deferred series breakdown
comments: 2026-02-27 - Ava Kim: Initial ticket created after spike with frontend team. Spike notes attached. Decimation heuristics proposed: reservoir sampling + peak-preserving guardrails.
2026-03-02 - Ravi Patel: Reviewed spike. Added requirement to expose token variables for spacing and stroke (comfort with product theming).
2026-03-05 - Marcus Lee (Frontend): Implementation spike shows main-thread reduction ~37% using canvas strip + 3-node legend. Shared a prototype branch: feat/summary-rendering.

2026-03-08 - Priya Nambiar (Accessibility): Reviewed proposed simplified DOM. Suggested aria pattern: one live-region summarizing top-3 series and an offscreen list for details when requested. Added VoiceOver notes.

2026-03-10 - Design review: Figma comps updated with keyboard flows and 'open details' microinteraction. Feedback: make the affordance visually distinct at xs sizes. Action: Ravi to try a 2px elevated hit target token.
2026-03-12 - Engineering review: Concern about progressive hydration thresholds. Decision: start with deferred after 100ms idle and cap deferred series to 20 per batch. Need telemetry to iterate.

2026-03-14 - QA: Added test plan for Axe rules and keyboard flows. Found an issue where aria-live duplicates messages when toggling multiple series quickly. QA suggested debouncing announcements by 300ms. Added to engineering backlog.

2026-03-15 - Ravi Patel: Merged prototype PR to staging for broader perf testing (PR link in attachments). Next: run perf harness across macOS M1 and Linux g4dn-4xlarge emulation to capture real-world numbers.
